newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev opens down on rate cut, new fall seen.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev opens down on rate cut, new fall seen.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev was quoted between 1,750-1,950 per dollar at the opening of the local interbank market, down from Friday's close at around 1,685-1,700 in nervous trade, dealers said.

"The lev fell sharply in early quotes but there have been no trades so far. The bid/ask spread widened to 150-200 levs in anticipation of a further lev fall following the cut in the main interest rate," a commercial bank dealer said.
